item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 7 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 7 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 8:00 PM, 14 August 2026(Friday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Bataan and Zambales(San Antonio, Subic, Castillejos, Olongapo).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.


Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Zambales(Botolan, San Marcelino, Cabangan, Candelaria, Iba, Masinloc, Palauig, Santa Cruz, San Felipe, San Narciso), Cavite(Ternate, Naic, Tanza, Rosario, Bacoor, Cavite City, Noveleta, Imus, Kawit, General Trias, Maragondon, Magallanes, General Emilio Aguinaldo, Trece Martires, Dasmarinas, Alfonso, Indang, Carmona, Gen. Mariano Alvarez, Amadeo, Silang, Mendez), Batangas(Nasugbu, Lian, Tuy, Balayan, Calatagan), Tarlac(San Clemente, Camiling, Mayantoc, Santa Ignacia, San Jose, Capas, Bamban), Pampanga(Porac, Floridablanca, Mabalacat, Angeles, Sasmuan, Macabebe, Masantol, Santa Rita, Bacolor, San Fernando, Guagua, Lubao, Minalin, Santo Tomas, Apalit), Bulacan(Hagonoy, Bulakan, Obando, Marilao, Meycauayan, Norzagaray, San Jose del Monte, Malolos, Santa Maria, Balagtas, Guiguinto, Bocaue, Paombong, Calumpit, Pulilan, Plaridel, Pandi, Baliuag, Bustos, Angat), Quezon(General Nakar, Infanta, Real) and Laguna(Santa Maria, Mabitac, Pakil, Siniloan, Famy, Pangil, San Pedro, Binan, Santa Rosa) within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Metro Manila(Quezon City, Marikina, San Juan, Mandaluyong, Pasig) and Rizal(Rodriguez, Antipolo, San Mateo, Tanay) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.
